_description: Scores a dog's current submission across 9 dimensions to produce a gap diagnostic — telling BCS where to focus coaching first.

request.text: Moose is a 3 year old lab mix. He is good with other dogs and kids. He is house trained. He has been in foster care for 4 months.
request.foster_notes: Been with us 4 months. Loves fetch. Great with our kids.

dimensions.gap: No specific moment or memorable detail. Could describe any lab.
Single shot, fluorescent lighting, no eye contact.
Mentions kids and other dogs but vague — no specifics about home type or energy needs.
Reads like a form. No warmth, no relationship visible.
Energy level not communicated — adopter doesn't know what they're getting.
No intro video. Adopter arrives cold.
No coached story. No strong asset identified.
Nothing forms. Can't picture this dog anywhere.

response.coaching_summary: Moose has no story yet. An adopter reads this and feels nothing. Start with the personality hook — find the specific moment only this foster knows.
